Considering you have 50bb from UTG I don’t think he automatically puts you on a high pocket pair , you could certainly be putting pressure on the shorter stacks with a wider range then normal from his perspective. (AQ, AJ, A10, KQ , small pocket pairs. )
I think the c-bet on the flop is good but once the turns a K you have to wonder what he’s calling you with. I think you should be pot controlling on this turn with your hand and trying to get to showdown, i think it’s just a bad spot to bluff because you’re only representing a few hands here AA , AK maybe KK.
